key_points.text: As companies expand out from the internet into the rest of the economy — the proverbial bits to atoms — “the business models are becoming more complicated.
But as such companies become “the operating platform for commerce”, we also have an interesting paradigm where people, not governments.
This is especially true as payments become easier, as trust and payments become interwoven, and as online, peer-to-peer marketplaces address information asymmetry.
